text: I switched the kitchen radiator off for the winter, the valve is stuck at three.
Noted. Stuck at three usually means the pin underneath is seized, not the knob.
Booked the dentist for the first week of March, the one on the corner.
The plumber came by, he says the radiator valve is a Danfoss RA-N and needs a new insert.
So the fix is an insert, not a whole valve body. Worth asking him for the part number.
Watched the second half of the game at Tom's place, we lost anyway.
Bought a second bike lock, the old one is at the office.
Two locks, two places. That is the setup that actually survives a commute.
Repotted the big monstera, it had grown straight through the drainage holes.
